page_note: 该页为气候评述文章，正文双栏，页底为 Figure 12：1950–2025 年 Niño 3.4 区月度 ONI 海温异常的填色面积图，右侧附一幅标注“Niño3.4 Region”的定位地图。

heading.title: Monthly view of the Oceanic Niño Index (ONI) sea surface temperature anomalies in the Niño 3.4 region

components.evidence: blue fill runs below the 0.0 line, axis ticks continue -1.0, -2.0, -3.0
a black horizontal rule drawn across the plot at the 0.0 tick, splitting red from blue fill
one index series filled red / grey / blue by ENSO phase: legend "El Niño  Neutral  La Niña"
boxed legend with three dots sits over the plot area at lower right, above the 2015-2025 ticks
"Figure 12: Monthly view of the Oceanic Niño Index ... | Data: NOAA | Graphic: Gallagher Re" under the plot
monthly values from 1950 to 2025 form a continuous saw-toothed fill, roughly 890 points
data are monthly but ticks read 1950, 1955, 1960 ... 2025, one per 60 points
dashed rectangle over the equatorial Pacific with a boxed label "Niño3.4 Region"
the map panel is a light grey filled rectangle with grey landmasses, not white

new_components.name: threshold_colored_fill
new_components.evidence: fill switches red/grey/blue at the ±0.5 °C ENSO thresholds described in text, not at the zero line
new_components.why_it_matters: 读数时颜色并非按符号切换，而是按 ±0.5 阈值分段，因此“Neutral”灰色段可对应 -0.4 到 +0.4 的正负两侧数值，靠颜色不能判断正负。

new_components.name: locator_map_inset_beside_chart
new_components.evidence: a map panel sits level with the time-series plot and shares the single "Figure 12" caption
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一图号下并存时间序列与地图两块画面，表格若只导出一块，标题与被读取的标记就会错配。

new_components.name: legend_label_above_marker
new_components.evidence: the words "El Niño  Neutral  La Niña" are printed above their coloured dots, not to their right
new_components.why_it_matters: 图例文字与色点上下对位，解析器容易把标签与色点拆成两行，导致系列名丢失。

new_components.name: outward_tick_dashes_no_gridlines
new_components.evidence: each y label 3.0 ... -3.0 carries a short dash outside the axis; no grid lines cross the panel
new_components.why_it_matters: 面板内无网格，峰值只能靠与刻度短横的水平目测对齐，抬高了 ±5% 精度的读数难度。

spot_checks.mark: the tallest red peak, the 2015/16 El Niño maximum just left of the 2015 tick region
the red peak at the 1997/98 El Niño, between the 1995 and 2000 ticks
the red peak at the 1982/83 El Niño, just after the 1980 tick
a deep blue trough, most plausibly the 1973/74 La Niña between the 1970 and 1975 ticks; several troughs sit at this depth so it cannot be pinned uniquely
a shallow blue dip, e.g. the 2017/18 La Niña between the 2015 and 2020 ticks; many dips reach this depth
a moderate blue trough, e.g. the 2020/21 La Niña near the 2020 tick
a red peak reaching between the 1.0 and 2.0 ticks, e.g. the 1972/73 El Niño after the 1970 tick
a blue trough between the -1.0 and -2.0 ticks, e.g. the 2007/08 La Niña after the 2005 tick
a second red peak of the same height, e.g. the 2023/24 El Niño at the right end just before the 2025 tick
a blue trough near -1.6, e.g. the 2010/11 La Niña at the 2010 tick

difficulty_notes: 最卡的是标注键。图上约 890 个月度点，x 轴只印 16 个五年刻度（每个刻度间隔含 60 个数据点），图上无任何数值标签，能用于寻址的词只有 "El Niño / Neutral / La Niña" 三个图例名加 1950…2025 的刻度年份。给定值里 1.8 出现两次、多个 -1.5/-1.6/-1.8 级别的谷底同时存在，用“系列名+五年刻度”这一组键根本无法把一行对到唯一一个月。读数本身相对宽松：刻度间距 1.0，5% 容差在 2.6 上是 ±0.13、约 6 像素，尚可目测；但 -1.6 与 -1.5 只差 0.1（约 4–5 像素），一旦寻址不唯一，误配比误读更致命。
